text_block_list.text:
Wondering why Air Shakur hasn't shown up 
for training, I waited until evening—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, seriously? I thought for sure 
everyone was gone by now, but figured I'd 
drop by to check just in case...
choice_data_list:
I'm glad you're okay. I thought something 
had happened...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So annoying... Normally you'd be pissed 
off.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't stop typing out code. 
Before I knew it, it was this late.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
When I find some free time, maybe I'll try 
planting a timer in the code editor.

Since it looked somewhat like Air Shakur 
was reflecting on her actions in her own 
way, I decided to let the matter rest 
here.
